title: Exclude spend request G/L link from replication
summary: Table 6845 'Spend Request To G/L Link' is configured to exclude data replication, aligning with its parent Spend Request tables that already have this setting.
key_points: Adds ReplicateData = false to table 6845 Spend Request To G/L Link
The link table is now excluded from data replication, like the parent Spend Request tables
Resolves a cloud migration guard failure for an unreviewed table
No tests added because this is only a table property change
